About the Wednesday Dogfish Head Ride (Sussex Cyclists) group ride

A weekday-morning road ride from the brewery lot in Milton, a few miles inland from Rehoboth and Lewes. Two pace groups, 16 and 17 mph. The club also runs a faster 45-mile Tuesday drop paceline from the same spot.
